visual_action: A montage of clips shows Vice President Kamala Harris walking down the stairs of an airplane on a tarmac. She is shown in several different pantsuits (black, dark purple/brown, grey, blue) and appears confident and smiling.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: She is the sole subject of the video montage, shown in multiple clips.

spoken_summary: There is no speech or dialogue in the video; it is entirely set to music.
audio_music: A continuous, upbeat and modern instrumental track ('Radiant Bubbles' by Chaxti) plays throughout the video, creating a positive and confident mood.
editing_pacing: The video is a montage with quick cuts between different clips showing Kamala Harris in various outfits performing the same action.
central_claim: Kamala Harris is the next president of the United States.
intended_effect: To build support for and generate excitement about Kamala Harris as a presidential figure.
